
```{r}
#| include: false

set.seed(547)
# 1 cluster
metformin_lca_1 <- lca_iterations(
  data = data_lca,
  k = 1,
  b = 10,
  respvars = c("abc_comp_rev", "ADAMS_Total", "PedsQL"),
  fixed = c("visit"),
  randomno1 = 1,
  randomno2 = c(1, 1, 1),
  timevar = "visit",
  time4mc = 2,
  id = "id",
  catvar = NULL
)
# 2 clusters
metformin_lca_2 <- lca_iterations(
  data = data_lca,
  k = 2,
  b = 10,
  respvars = c("abc_comp_rev", "ADAMS_Total", "PedsQL"),

  randomno1 = 1,
  randomno2 = c(1, 1, 1),
  timevar = "visit",
  time4mc = 2,
  id = "id",
  catvar = NULL
)

  randomno2 = c(1, 1, 1),

  id = "id",
  catvar = NULL
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11

plot_grid(
  ggplot(lca_1_means, aes(x = Visit, y = Score, 
                          color = Cluster, group = Cluster)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.5)) +
    facet_wrap(.~Measure, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(),
  ggplot(lca_2_means, aes(x = Visit, y = Score, 
                          color = Cluster, group = Cluster)) +
```
